note: static = threshold analog (free-label-fit classifier, ranked once, fit on a held-out quarter of cell100 clusters, sd=0 across seeds). ts_online = learned analog (self-trained, online-refit every R verified labels, Thompson sampling over cells). static has a labeling advantage (free labels from a held-out cluster quarter, beyond the audit budget) that ts_online does not get; this asymmetry is inherent to sim_generic.py's existing policy definitions, not an E03 change.
